baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain صَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ... شَاقُّوا الرَّسُولَ is answered by لَن يَضُرُّوا اللَّهَ ... وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A traversable route is diverted and a community is split against the bearer of the message. Because the attempted loss cannot reach God, its effective endpoint shifts onto the obstructors' own intentional program: the blockage rebounds as loss of footing and efficacy in their works.

activation_trace.role: Diversion and prevention supply the initiating act of turning traffic away from the route.
The extended traversable road makes the object of obstruction a functioning passage, not an abstract topic.
A group fissured by conflict turns opposition to the messenger into a social break in the route-bearing community.
The bearer and borne message identify the transmission line against which the split is made.
Loss contrary to benefit marks the effect that is categorically denied as reaching God.
Falling and descent give the obstructors' program the downward endpoint denied against God.
Purposeful action is the concrete human product whose efficacy collapses.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists offenses and then appends an unrelated penalty.
changed_reading.after: The ayah traces one redirected causal line: attempted obstruction cannot terminate in damage to God, so it terminates in the obstructionists' own purposeful work losing effect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى stands between opposition to the messenger and the denial of any harm to God.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal succession, unveiled meaning, and gentle route-direction create a threshold. The later opposition is therefore not merely distance from a message; it is the deliberate production of an opposing side after the route has become visible.

activation_trace.role: Sequence after a prior state makes disclosure a temporal threshold crossed before opposition.
Emergence into visibility removes simple hiddenness as an account of the later break.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign ties clarity to an intelligible communication event.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the content that had already become available.
The opposite half makes opposition a chosen side relative to the disclosed route.
Communal rupture turns the chosen side into an enacted cleavage rather than private uncertainty.

changed_reading.before: After guidance became clear is only a chronological aside.
changed_reading.after: The phrase is the causal hinge: visibility converts distance into chosen cleavage, increasing the diagnostic force of the ensuing collapse of works.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ names the fate of purposeful activity without specifying that its historical trace simply vanishes.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus inventory keeps three material failure modes alive: intake that swells toward death, a wound that relapses and leaves an effect, and a well whose water departs. They coexist as models of work that may remain outwardly present while losing health, yield, or usable depth.

activation_trace.role: Lethal swelling after harmful grazing models apparent intake or growth that contains its own failure.
A relapsed wound with a remaining mark models failed healing without erasing the visible history.
A well whose water is gone models retained structure deprived of productive resource.
Intentional work is the substrate whose viability, not necessarily visibility, is removed.

changed_reading.before: Nullification means that every deed is simply deleted from view.
changed_reading.after: Nullification can be read as loss of viability, yield, or standing within work that may still look swollen, scarred, or structurally present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact opening offense in 47:1 ends with works being sent astray, while 47:9 ties their collapse to aversion toward what was sent down. Read with 47:32, the work first loses its destination through refusal of reception and then loses viability.

activation_trace.role: Deviation from guidance supplies the trajectory failure attached to the same obstructing clause.
The worked or traveled road lets deeds be heard as courses whose destination can be lost.
Aversion opposed to acceptance supplies the motive that disables reception.
Something delivered downward supplies the message whose arrival is refused.
The repeated fall of works gives refusal of reception a terminal consequence.
The focus recurrence gathers misdirection and refused descent into the announced future collapse.

structural_cues: 47:1 repeats the focus ayah's opening sequence nearly verbatim and substitutes أَضَلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ for its closing وَسَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ.
47:9 repeats the same ح ب ط plus ع م ل closure and supplies hatred of what descended as an explicit causal clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two repeated work-outcomes and the rejected descent; I infer a path from failed orientation to failed viability. A live alternative is that ضلال and حبط are parallel verdicts rather than temporal stages.

changed_reading.before: The works are canceled in one opaque terminal act.
changed_reading.after: Their collapse has a trajectory: obstruction and refused reception make the work miss its destination before its viability is brought down.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 47:2 the same root field used for the focus subjects' covering is turned toward covering bad acts, followed by repair of their condition. The object and agent reverse the effect: covering disclosed truth seals work into failure, while covering harmful residue protects and repairs the person.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the focus subjects' active concealment against what has become visible.
Protective covering that makes faults lose effect reverses the focus direction of concealment.
What causes hurt is the residue covered in the reparative sequence, clarifying the beneficial object of covering.
Restoration against corruption supplies the positive result paired with protective covering.
A repaired, eased condition locates the benefit in the human bearer rather than in a divine need.
Failed healing in the focus contrasts with the repaired condition produced by the beneficial covering.

structural_cues: 47:2 coordinates covering bad acts with repairing بَال, while 47:32 coordinates covering truth with collapsing works.
The opposed outcomes depend on what is covered and toward whom the effect flows.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root in opposed constructions and a repair sequence; I infer a deliberate reversal between concealment and protective covering. The alternative is simple lexical polysemy used without a designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: كفر is only a fixed group label unrelated to the closing fate of works.
changed_reading.after: The ayah participates in a covering economy: concealment of disclosed guidance makes work fail, whereas protective covering of harmful residue restores the person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context places people in reciprocal testing, says that supporting God returns as support and stabilized feet, and names God as patron. The focus denial of harming God is the negative counterpart: help and harm language marks alignment, but the realized effects land in human stability, patronage, and work.

activation_trace.role: Testing that makes condition appear places human conflict in a revelatory relation rather than making God its vulnerable patient.
Reciprocal aid supplies the positive relational counterpart to the focus's denied harm.
Strengthening and stabilization show where the returned effect of alignment is realized.
Feet give the relational effect a human point of contact and connect it to the route model.
Patronage through love and aid distinguishes protected alignment from the absence of a patron.
Denied loss against God becomes the negative pole whose consequence must be located elsewhere.

structural_cues: 47:4 explicitly places conflict under a test of some people through others.
47:7 uses the same ن ص ر root on both sides of a conditional and immediately locates the result in the addressees' feet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal support, testing, patronage, and stabilized feet; I infer that predicates directed toward God encode human alignment whose effects return to humans. The alternative is that each expression is an independent idiom without a shared transfer mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They try and fail to inflict a direct injury on God.
changed_reading.after: Their posture is genuinely oppositional, but the relational consequence cannot alter God; it resolves in human instability and the collapse of their own work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pasture-sickness branch of حبط becomes unexpectedly concrete when the context portrays the rejecters eating as cattle and later depicts hot water cutting entrails. Apparent consumption and enlargement can therefore be the carrier of internal destruction rather than evidence of flourishing.

activation_trace.role: Fatal swelling from harmful grazing supplies the focus-anchored metabolic failure model.
Repeated taking of food supplies the intake process through which the failure can develop.
Grazing livestock make the focus inventory's pasture sickness materially resonant rather than free-floating.
Hot water supplies an ingested substance whose apparent provision becomes injury.
Severing supplies the destructive action produced inside the consumer.
The entrails locate the destructive result internally, matching the self-contained failure of toxic intake.

structural_cues: 47:12 explicitly compares their eating to the eating of livestock.
47:15 reverses river abundance into an ingested hot water that destroys the drinker internally.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the pasture-sickness branch, livestock consumption, and destructive ingestion; I infer that outwardly accumulating works may metabolize into their bearers' ruin. The live alternative is that the eating scenes remain separate eschatological imagery and only loosely analogize حبط.

changed_reading.before: Abundant activity is evidence that the works remain effective until an external verdict erases them.
changed_reading.after: Activity may swell through its own intake while already carrying an internal mechanism of collapse; abundance and invalidity can coexist for a time.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:14 contrasts standing on visible evidence with evil work made beautiful and followed through desire; 47:16 shows hearing that does not become comprehension; 47:17 shows guidance compounding when followed. Clarity is thus a bifurcation between amplifying guidance and a cosmetic counter-feedback that makes failing work look good.

activation_trace.role: Visible evidence supplies one side of the contextual contrast around the focus's disclosure threshold.
Applied beautification supplies a process that can mask a work's bad condition from its bearer.
Purposeful work is explicitly the object beautified, linking the cosmetic process to the focus outcome.
Following supplies the sustained movement by which the beautified course is enacted.
The inclination of the self supplies the directional bias that competes with visible guidance.
Hearing as understanding and compliance exposes the gap between acoustic reception and actual uptake.
Repeated route-guidance supplies the alternative feedback loop in which reception increases orientation.
Growth makes successful reception cumulative rather than static.
The focus disclosure anchors both contextual feedback paths to the moment after visibility.

structural_cues: 47:14 is an explicit كَمَن contrast between visible evidence and beautified bad work.
47:16 and 47:17 place failed uptake and increasing guidance in adjacent contrasting sequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrast, beautification, failed uptake, and increasing guidance; I infer two feedback loops after disclosure. The alternative is a static classification of two groups without processual feedback.

changed_reading.before: Once guidance is clear, only assent or blunt denial remains.
changed_reading.after: Clarity can feed either increasing orientation or a desire-driven cosmetic loop; the focus collapse punctures work that looked attractive inside the second loop.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus fissure against the messenger expands through 47:22-24 into severed kinship, disabled hearing and sight, failed reflection, and locked hearts. External path-blocking and communal cleavage propagate inward as closure of the faculties that could receive the route.

activation_trace.role: Communal fission supplies the focus-level break that the context distributes through other relations.
A barrier like a mountain supplies the obstruction that becomes internal closure in the contextual sequence.
Cutting a bond supplies the enacted social form of the focus fissure.
Kinship identifies the living social connection that is severed.
A stopped opening turns social severance into a blocked channel of reception.
Blindness of inward perception removes the capacity to orient by the disclosed route.
Considering consequences supplies the reflective movement that the locked condition prevents.
Closure and hardening locate the final barrier within the heart.

structural_cues: 47:22-24 runs without an intervening alternative subject from social cutting through sensory disablement to locked hearts.
The sequence moves from relations in the land to the organs of reception and reflection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several kinds of severance in sequence; I infer propagation from public rupture to inward closure. A live alternative is that these are coordinated consequences without a directional progression.

changed_reading.before: Opposing the messenger is an isolated act of external confrontation.
changed_reading.after: It is a fissuring process that cuts social bonds and then hardens the very channels by which guidance could be heard, seen, and reflected upon.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:25 repeats the focus disclosure formula inside a backward turn, and 47:26 specifies promised obedience in only part of the matter to those hostile to the descent. Opposition to the messenger can therefore operate as retrogression and partitioned allegiance, not only open attack.

activation_trace.role: Return toward a former position supplies the retrograde motion after disclosure.
Turning the back makes retrogression a bodily and directional rejection.
The repeated after-threshold locks the backward turn to a prior disclosure event.
Visibility confirms that the backward motion follows, rather than precedes, disclosure.
Route-direction identifies what the actors reverse away from.
Inner embellishment supplies a mechanism that makes the retrograde choice attractive.
Extended time supplies room in which reversal can be normalized rather than appearing instantaneous.
Obedience supplies the allegiance that is redirected toward opponents of the descent.
A divided portion makes the allegiance structurally partial rather than simply absent.
The matter or affair is the field partitioned by selective obedience.
Hidden inward content lets divided allegiance coexist with a less openly oppositional surface.
The opposite half anchors selective obedience as a focus-level partition of allegiance.

structural_cues: 47:25 repeats مِن بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى from the focus almost word for word.
47:26 immediately renders accommodation as obedience in some of the matter and closes by naming hidden content.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula, backward motion, partial obedience, and secrecy; I infer a process description for the focus opposition. The alternative is that 47:25-26 concern a narrower group whose behavior only parallels 47:32.

changed_reading.before: شاقوا الرسول requires only explicit, total confrontation.
changed_reading.after: Opposition may be enacted by reversing after recognition and splitting obedience across rival allegiances, even while part of that split remains concealed.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:29-31 moves from hidden rancor to extraction, recognition by marks and slanted speech, knowledge of works, and testing of reports. The focus pairing of covering and becoming clear now reads as an assay: pressure makes latent allegiance legible, after which the works lose their claimed standing.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the latent state that the contextual extraction and recognition undo.
Coming into view supplies the focus endpoint of the contextual assay.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latent content to evidence.
Recognition by an effect or sign supplies the reader of the newly exposed evidence.
A visible mark makes inner condition legible on the surface.
Speech bent toward an implication makes hidden allegiance leak through verbal direction.
Disclosure to knowledge supplies the epistemic endpoint of marks and inflection.
Purposeful works are explicitly included in what is known, joining latent allegiance to outward production.
An examination that makes condition appear supplies the stress process of the assay.
Knowledge of report and inward reality joins tested outward news to what lies beneath it.
Relapse with a remaining trace lets exposed works persist as evidence while losing healthy standing.

structural_cues: The branchless root ض غ ن in 47:29 is used only as the structural label for the hidden rancor that the ayah says will be brought out.
47:30 repeats recognition, then closes with God's knowledge of works; 47:31 immediately adds repeated testing and reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, extraction, visible and audible signs, known works, and testing; I infer an assay that reveals latent allegiance before invalidation. The alternative is mere omniscience plus unrelated recognition cues, without a staged assay.

changed_reading.before: The focus names already obvious opponents and then erases their deeds.
changed_reading.after: The opponents' orientation may be latent and cosmetically productive until stress, marks, and speech make it legible; collapse removes the standing of exposed work rather than its evidentiary trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah commands obedience to God and the messenger and warns the addressees not to invalidate their own works. Its human-facing prohibition mirrors the focus's divine future verb, allowing a layered process in which oppositional conduct initiates the invalidation that God brings to judgment.

activation_trace.role: Obedient alignment supplies the preventable alternative to opposition after disclosure.
The repeated messenger makes the command the direct relational inverse of the focus opposition.
Actively removing a thing's validity supplies the human-addressed counterpart to divine إحباط.
The same purposeful-work object makes the mirror between the adjacent warnings exact.
The divine future fall is the adjudicated completion paired with the human prohibition.

structural_cues: 47:32 and 47:33 are adjacent and end with near-synonymous transitive verbs governing أَعْمَال.
The opposed messenger relations, شَاقُّوا and أَطِيعُوا, stand in matching causal positions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adjacent divine prediction and human prohibition over the same object; I infer layered agency between chosen opposition and adjudicated invalidation. The alternative is that the command only warns a different audience by analogy.

changed_reading.before: God's nullification is wholly detached from the agents' handling of their own work.
changed_reading.after: The work is judicially nullified, yet the adjacent command makes that result preventable and partly self-incurred through the choice between obedience and opposition.

context_deltas.mechanism: 47:35 promises that aligned works will not be deprived, while 47:38 says withholding is against one's own self, God is self-sufficient, people are needy, and turning away leads to replacement. The focus's denied harm acquires an explicit redirected patient: the actor loses work, due, and place while God remains sufficient.

activation_trace.role: Loss that deprives someone of a right or work supplies the outcome explicitly denied to aligned agents.
Work as earned due or wage makes non-deprivation the positive contrast to focus nullification.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the demanded outward flow that withholding interrupts.
Repeated withholding supplies the concrete attempt to retain benefit by blocking its flow.
The actor's own self is the stated patient onto whom the loss rebounds.
Self-sufficiency makes divine non-injury structural rather than merely a failed human attempt.
Human need identifies why interrupted giving damages the withholder rather than God.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the institutional consequence of persistent turning away.
Standing in another's place makes replacement a change of human agents, not a repair of divine capacity.
The focus denial of loss to God is completed by the context's identification of self-loss.

structural_cues: 47:38 explicitly predicates withholding against the withholder's own self and immediately contrasts divine sufficiency with human need.
The same ayah makes turning away lead to substitution of another people, while 47:35 denies deprivation of aligned works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-directed withholding, divine sufficiency, human need, non-deprived work, and replacement; I infer that the focus's blocked harm rebounds as loss of work and role. The alternative is to limit 47:38 to finance without extending its reflexive logic to 47:32.

changed_reading.before: Not harming God is only an abstract assertion of invulnerability.
changed_reading.after: It is also a causal redirection: attempted withholding or obstruction impoverishes the agent, voids the agent's work and due, and can remove the agent from the role altogether.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet-authorized but form-distant mapping from ش ق ق to ن ش ق, so it must not be rendered as the lexical gloss of شَاقُّوا. It remains anchored to the exact focus form and gains contextual resonance from the locked heart; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory self-entrapment image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: شَاقُّوا الرَّسُولَ is the exact focus attachment; the outlier asks whether opposition also images entry into a bond from which the opponents cannot free themselves.

activation_trace.role: Being caught in a snare or neck-loop contributes a packet-licensed image of opposition becoming self-capture.
Hard closure in the heart supplies a contextual state in which the self-capturing loop cannot open.
The fall of works gives the exploratory snare a focus-internal consequence.

changed_reading.before: Opposition creates a trap only for the messenger's mission.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the act of opposition may close into a snare around its own agents, leaving their work rather than the message unable to escape collapse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The water-system reading is cross-domain but uses only direct focus inventories for obstruction, route, and a dried well. It is valid as a material analogy, not as a claim that سبيل or حبط literally denotes one hydraulic installation here; prose should mark it as an image of redirected loss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: صَدُّوا عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ and سَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ join obstruction of access to the focus inventory's loss of well-water.

activation_trace.role: A road leading to water turns the obstructed access into a life-bearing route.
The extended traversable way stabilizes the spatial connection between access and destination.
A well left structurally present after its water departs supplies the rebound onto the obstructors' work.
Purposeful labor is the human installation that remains but no longer yields.

changed_reading.before: Blocking the path successfully deprives only other travelers.
changed_reading.after: In the hydraulic image, those who block access to the water-route discover that their own well of work is what loses its water.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The wound branch makes nullification compatible with a remaining mark, which is surprising because cancellation is often imagined as total disappearance. It remains anchored in the focus حبط and is supported by contextual disease and exposure, but prose must not infer surviving merit; only evidentiary or historical residue remains live.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: سَيُحْبِطُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ can activate a relapsed wound whose trace remains while its healing fails.

activation_trace.role: A wound that relapses and leaves a mark distinguishes loss of health from disappearance of evidence.
Purposeful deeds provide the historical trace that can remain visible after losing standing.
Disease that weakens movement supplies a contextual analogue for activity deprived of effective motion.
Extraction from concealment lets the residual trace function as evidence of the condition that invalidated the work.

changed_reading.before: Once works are nullified, they leave no readable remainder.
changed_reading.after: Their merit and efficacy can fail while their scar remains legible as evidence of the concealed allegiance that produced them.

strongest_changes: The repeated frame in 47:1 and causal echo in 47:9 turn nullification into a trajectory from misdirection and refused reception to collapse.
The near-verbatim formula in 47:25 and partial obedience in 47:26 recast post-clarity opposition as retrogression and partitioned allegiance.
The extraction, marks, speech-inflection, and testing sequence in 47:29-31 makes latent opposition an assay whose result becomes legible in works.
47:33 and 47:38 layer human and divine agency: agents participate in invalidating their work, the loss rebounds on themselves, and persistent turning can end in replacement.
summary.what_was_special: The focus did not settle into one punitive paraphrase. Route, disclosure, social fissure, failed reception, metabolic implosion, dried infrastructure, and residual scar all remained anchored mechanisms; the odd non-dominant ش ق ق to ن ش ق mapping was retained only with explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated outcomes ضلال and حبط may be sequential stages or parallel descriptions of one verdict.
The toxic-pasture, dry-well, and wound images are packet-grounded analogies, but their relative weight in the focus remains uncertain.
أعمال may cover the subjects' whole purposive record, their anti-message program, or both at different scales.
The self-snaring outlier depends on a form-distant mapped root and should never displace the stronger cleavage reading.
